subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Which equation produces a reciprocal graph?
questions.explain: y = 1/x is the standard reciprocal graph with two curved branches.

questions.q: Find the midpoint of (-2, 4) and (6, -2).
questions.explain: Average each coordinate: ((-2+6)/2,(4-2)/2)=(2,1).

questions.q: Which equation gives a graph parallel to the y-axis?
questions.explain: x = 4 is a vertical line, parallel to the y-axis.

questions.q: Find the gradient of the line through (-1, 3) and (2, 12).
What is the gradient of y = 3x + 5?
questions.explain: In y = mx + c the gradient is m = 3.

questions.q: What are the coordinates where y = 2x - 6 crosses the x-axis?
questions.explain: On the x-axis y=0, so 0=2x-6 gives x=3, the point (3, 0).

questions.q: On y = 2x + 1, what is y when x = 3?
On a distance-time graph, what does a horizontal line represent?
questions.explain: No change in distance over time means the object is stationary.

questions.q: Does the point (2, 5) lie on the line y = 2x + 1?
questions.explain: y = 2×2 + 1 = 5, so the point lies on the line.

questions.q: What is the gradient of the line 2y = 6x + 4?
questions.explain: Divide by 2 to get y = 3x + 2, so the gradient is 3.

questions.q: A car travels at constant speed. What does its distance-time graph look like?
options: A straight line through the origin
questions.explain: Constant speed gives a straight, sloped distance-time line.

questions.q: Find the midpoint of (2, 3) and (8, 7).
questions.explain: Average each coordinate: ((2+8)/2,(3+7)/2)=(5,5).

questions.q: A line is parallel to y = 4x - 1. What is its gradient?
questions.explain: Parallel lines share the same gradient, which is 4.

questions.q: A line has gradient -2 and passes through (1, 5). What is its equation?
questions.explain: Using y=mx+c with 5=-2(1)+c gives c=7, so y = -2x + 7.

questions.q: Which equation produces a cubic graph?
questions.explain: A cubic has an x^3 term, so y = x^3 + 2.

questions.q: On y = 5x - 4, what is x when y = 11?
questions.explain: 11 = 5x - 4 gives 5x = 15, so x = 3.

questions.q: What is the gradient of a horizontal line?
questions.explain: A horizontal line has no rise, so its gradient is 0.

questions.q: Which type of graph is a U-shaped curve?
questions.explain: A quadratic such as y = x^2 produces a U-shaped parabola.

questions.q: Which point lies on the line y = -x + 4?
questions.explain: For x=2, y = -2 + 4 = 2, so (2, 2) lies on the line.

questions.q: On a distance-time graph, a steeper line means the object is...
questions.explain: A steeper gradient means more distance per unit time, so faster.

questions.q: Which line is parallel to y = 3x - 2?
questions.explain: Parallel lines have the same gradient 3, so y = 3x + 5.

questions.q: What is the gradient of the line through (0, 4) and (2, 0)?
